instructions: The marks are indicated in the right-hand margin.
There are NINE questions in this paper.

questions.text:
Which of the following is the meaning of beneficent?
(i) Useful
(ii) Kind
(iii) Less
(iv) Cause and effect
(Choose the correct option)

Give the meanings of the following foreign phrases :
(i) Bon voyage
(ii) Alma mater

Use the following phrases to form sentences :
(i) Pull someone's leg
(ii) Two-faced

Which of the following is odd man out of the group?
(i) Dad
(ii) Mom
(iii) Brother
(iv) Uncle
(Choose the correct option)

Which of the following is the prefix of 'agreement'?
(i) Non
(ii) Un
(iii) Dis
(iv) A
(Choose the correct option)

Make antonyms of the following by adding suitable prefixes :
(i) Grace
(ii) Clean

Fill in the blanks with the correct form of verbs given in brackets :
(i) He often ______ (go) shopping on the weekend.
(ii) My sister ______ (work) as a waitress.
(iii) Tom's not here. He is out ______ (visit) his mother.
(iv) Do you still ______ (belong) to the Tennis Club?
